Thrilled to share that CrowdStrike 's early-career program has been named one of the Top 20 winners in Abode 's inaugural Early-Career Engagement Awards! 🎉 Creating a great candidate experience doesn't stop when an offer is accepted. Some of the most meaningful engagement happens before day one, and we're proud to be recognized for the intentional work our team puts into that journey across all five award categories: keep-warm engagement, community building, mentorship, renege prevention, and intern-to-full-time conversion. This recognition belongs to every CrowdStriker who has played a role in building a world-class early-career experience. Thank you! 🏆 Read more here: https://lnkd.in/gG84yHXr

I recently had the opportunity to attend the CrowdStrike Intern Conference in San Jose alongside over 100 interns from across the company. Over three days, I learned from leaders across engineering, HR, public policy, and professional services, participated in networking sessions, and collaborated with an incredible team on a capstone project. I’m especially proud that my Capstone Project team, Connor Fox , Gavin Nazir , Alejandro Cuevas , Nebiy Giday , won our Capstone Category- “How to Effectively use AI in the Workforce Without Losing Human Edge”, advanced to the final round, and ultimately placed 2nd overall after presenting our solution to CrowdStrike executives. Beyond the competition, my biggest takeaway was seeing how collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives can turn ideas into impactful solutions. Thank you to everyone who helped organize the conference and to my teammates for making this such a rewarding experience. I’m excited to continue learning and growing throughout the rest of my internship!
